purpose: Ten observation scenarios derived from one public civic address, not ten independent locations. These inputs are not accuracy ground truth and do not prescribe expected API results.

reference.address: 200 Larkin Street, San Francisco, CA 94102, United States
reference.note: The museum's official contact page verifies the baseline address, not geocoding outcomes for these variations.

cases.scenario: Complete public civic address as the reference input.

cases.scenario: Postcode omitted from the reference input.
cases.input: 200 Larkin Street, San Francisco, CA, United States

cases.scenario: House number omitted; observe the returned location level.
